purpose: Non-admission discovery of German regulatory insurer and elemental-cat insurance context and the exact Destatis Zensus 2022 regional buildings/dwellings product, with explicitly blocked GDV automated text/data mining pending permission and separate scientific/rights review.

entries.name: BaFin 2025 insurer complaint statistics with reported in-force risk-count denominators
entries.spatial_scope: Germany reporting insurers and lines in regulator complaint reporting population
entries.temporal_scope: 2025 complaint publication; in-force counts may refer to 2024 gross premiums and company coverage thresholds
entries.resolution_or_granularity: XLSX published complaint counts and denominators by insurer and class where eligible; missing when threshold or data status not met
entries.note: Selection-biased: insurers with no complaints absent; in-force risk counts omitted below 10 million EUR threshold on 2024 earned gross class premiums and for EEA undertakings not required to submit; numbers can represent insured persons in group insurance and are not unique policies or buildings. Not fit as a nationwide carrier census or TIV without additional evidence.

entries.name: Destatis Zensus 2022 regional tables, buildings and dwellings, machine-readable CSV
entries.provider: Statistisches Bundesamt and Statistische Ämter des Bundes und der Länder
entries.spatial_scope: Germany, official country, Land, Kreis and Gemeinde levels at the Zensus 15 May 2022 reference date
entries.temporal_scope: Snapshot as of 15 May 2022; NOT annual 2025 insurer property stock
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Publisher original XLSX 21,451,209 bytes, 8 real worksheets including CSV-Gebäude, CSV-Wohnungen, Erläuterungen zur Methodik and Erläuterung zu CSV-Tabellen; actual CSV-Gebäude first-row headers include Berichtszeitpunkt, _RS, Name, Regionalebene, GEBAEUDEART_SYS_1, ...
entries.note: Original official 2022-05-15 census product is distinct from 100m/1km building grids. Exact original https://www.destatis.de/static/DE/zensus/gitterdaten/Regionaltabelle_Gebaeude_Wohnungen.xlsx was retrieved intact on GitHub run 41737802098: 21,451,209 bytes SHA-256 82da8578a4657e20752b436a756ed27846c77f96e3f7333bdea7f4fe29a8b551; workbook sheet titles/OOXML verified. Later exact-head run 41738437581 verified original CSV-Gebäude first-row source headers only, with field _RS and Regionalebene, without republishing numerical source rows. The XLSX's CSV-like sheets remain in the same XLSX; a separately published CSV asset was not independently verified. No actual Kreis building count, nested GEBAEUDEART_SYS code meaning, suppression symbols, exact source reuse licence, current 2025 company contract mapping, or admission validated. It is invalid to treat mixed administrative levels (Bund/Land/Kreis/Gemeinde) as independent risk-site rows; require exact 5-digit _RS and the Kreis Regionalebene. Do not infer 2025 insurer risk locations or TIV from 2022 census counts.

entries.name: GDV 2026 Naturgefahrenreport county/district residential catastrophe loss frequency and severity
entries.spatial_scope: Approximately 400 German districts/cities; insurer industry aggregate only
entries.temporal_scope: Report 2026, historic household/building catastrophe experience including 2002-2024 period and selected 2025 updates
entries.resolution_or_granularity: District-level aggregate insured building event loss frequency, average claim and largest cumul event, split wind/hail and flood/heavy rain/earth movement/snow as available
entries.note: Historical normalized district losses are industry-wide and represent insured coverage, not building-level hazard intensities or a specific insurer's actual losses. Preserve insured contract denominator, event as-of, inflation normalization, vintage and peril class; do not distribute reported industry claims into Allianz insured addresses. Provider licence page (21 May 2025): https://www.gdv.de/gdv/statistik/nutzungsbedingungen-fuer-statistikdaten-und-deren-visualisierung-188704. Sec. 2.3 expressly reserves text/data mining and requires explicit consent; sec. 2.2 restricts stand-alone economic exploitation or resale of the material. Sec. 2.1 permits certain attributed uses but is NOT blanket automated data harvesting or model-input permission. Separate licence and scientific review of each exact dataset and permitted extraction path mandatory; keep blocked in the interim.

entries.name: GDV district-level residential elemental-peril take-up interactive map (publication-vintage review)

entries.resolution_or_granularity: Percent of residential buildings with full elemental-peril cover by district; excludes certain stand-alone heavy-rain contracts
entries.note: A landkreis-level market share of insured buildings is NOT the company-specific percentage or a unique set of coverage addresses; some historical policies included; coverage here means full elemental-peril insurance, not all general homeowners protection. Machine-download rights and spatial/vintage consistency must be reviewed. Keep county IDs, numerator/denominator definitions and publisher revision.
